_fields.listen: Local TCP port for incoming client connections (e.g. 127.0.0.1:2222)
_fields.target: Target backend service address to request from the server (e.g. 127.0.0.1:22)
_fields.path: HTTP proxy endpoint URL path matching server (e.g. /tunnel)
_fields.transport: Client transport protocol: 'h2' (HTTP/2 Stream POST), 'h2c' (cleartext H2), 'grpc' (gRPC streaming), 'wt' (WebTransport over H3/QUIC), 'masque' (RFC 9298 MASQUE CONNECT), 'h3' (HTTP/3)
_fields.network: Local client listener mode: 'tcp' (listen on TCP port only), 'udp' (listen on UDP port only), 'both' (listen on both TCP and UDP ports simultaneously)
_fields.token: Proxy-Authorization Token matching server (aliases: auth_token, psk)
_fields.sni: TLS Server Name Indication (SNI) disguise domain
_fields.insecure: Skip TLS certificate chain verification (recommended when using self-signed certs)
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
